slides.title: Footer Placement Fix
slides.text: Moves the WorkTrack footer below the Bus & Shuttle Time section so the page footer appears at the bottom after the timetable content. No attendance calculations, saved records, or transport times are changed.

slides.title: Bus & Shuttle Time
slides.text: Adds a dedicated Bus & Shuttle Time option to the menu, bringing the ICAD–Catering bus timetable and CCS Catering Shuttle 1 and Shuttle 2 schedules into one responsive page with separate tabs and departure-time search.

slides.title: Responsive Month Navigation
slides.text: Keeps Current month, Previous month and Next month controls side-by-side in the Dashboard and Calendar on phones and desktop. The Calendar heading moves above the controls on narrow screens to prevent overflow. Attendance calculations and saved records are unchanged.

slides.title: Attendance Date & Editing Fix
slides.text: Fixes local-timezone month-end filtering so the final day of a month is included. Attendance records can be corrected across dates, including check-in/out, break minutes, status, overtime reason and notes. Editing a record updates its existing row and checks for duplicate target dates.

slides.title: Attendance Persistence Hardening
slides.text: Attendance saves now use an authoritative no-cache database read with retry and a final post-reload verification. The app no longer reports success from a session-only record. Mobile Dashboard month controls remain side-by-side.

slides.title: Attendance Persistence & Mobile Month Controls
slides.text: Attendance saves now use the database user/date key with post-save verification, so records remain available after refresh. Dashboard, Calendar, History and Report month controls stay side-by-side on mobile.
